changelog: Fixed repeated wallpaper reloads and frequent media reads on some devices after setting a wallpaper, along with an inverted permission check in the wallpaper picker. Fixed the label position of the Stack option in the lasso menu. The gallery widget fixes tilted photos and leftover stacked visuals after expanding; its version remains 2.1 (versionCode 18), so uninstall it and reinstall from tsf-widgets-v1 to apply the fix.
changelogZh: 修复设置壁纸后部分设备反复重载壁纸与读取媒体文件的问题，修正壁纸页权限判断。修正圈选菜单「图标堆叠」文字位置。相册小部件修复展开后照片倾斜及残留堆叠显示，版本号仍为 2.1（versionCode 18），如需更新请先卸载相册插件再从 tsf-widgets-v1 重新安装。
